highlights.title: Anthropic, OpenAI among firms facing new scrutiny under EU AI Act enforcement powers
highlights.description: The European Commission can demand to inspect AI models, restrict market access and fine providers up to 15 million euros or 3% of turnover.

highlights.title: OpenAI rebuts Apple trade secrets allegations in new response with receipts
highlights.description: Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI last month, accusing the firm behind ChatGPT of stealing trade secrets related to hardware development. Nearly a month later, OpenAI has published a detailed response to many of Apple’s claims in the form of a blog post.

highlights.title: Huawei’s Top Scientist Warns of Chip Limit Nvidia Will Soon Face
highlights.description: Huawei Technologies Co.’s top semiconductor scientist warned of the looming physical limits Western chipmaking giants including Nvidia Corp. face in their pursuit of more powerful processors, in a rare public appearance streamed in China.

highlights.title: Apple Briefly Removes Telegram App For Child Abuse Content
highlights.description: Apple Inc. briefly removed the Telegram messaging app from its App Store after finding content on the platform that violated a ban on child sexual abuse material.

highlights.title: Russia escalates dispute with Apple over mandatory app preinstallation
highlights.description: Reuters reports that Russia’s antitrust regulator has opened a formal case against Apple over the company’s failure to preinstall the state-backed MAX messenger and Russia’s RuStore app marketplace on its devices. Here are the details.

highlights.title: CXMT Narrows Gap With SK Hynix and Samsung in Smartphone Memory
highlights.description: China’s state-backed CXMT Corp. is poised to produce smartphone memory chips that are on par with the industry’s most advanced designs, highlighting the speed at which Beijing is gaining ground in a field critical for AI deployment.

highlights.title: Apple’s India Sales Top $10 Billion on Widening Retail Push
highlights.description: Apple Inc. exceeded $10 billion in annual sales in India for the first time last fiscal year, underscoring surging demand for its pricey devices in a market where it’s steadily ramping up its retail network.

highlights.title: Apple plans to open iPhone clipboard access to Windows PCs
highlights.description: Apple has outlined plans to let users copy and paste content between an iPhone and a Windows PC, following an interoperability request from Microsoft in the European Union. Here are the details.

highlights.title: Chinese Startup AI² Robotics Is Said to Consider Hong Kong IPO
highlights.description: Chinese robot maker AI² Robotics is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people familiar with the matter, looking to tap into interest for the growing sector.

highlights.title: Alibaba-Backed 3D-Modeling Startup Vast Is Said to Weigh HK IPO
highlights.description: Vast, a 3D-modeling startup, is considering an initial public offering in Hong Kong, according to people with knowledge of the matter.

ai.title: The studio behind Pokémon struggles to find its voice in Beast of Reincarnation
ai.description:
You have to imagine that the team at Game Freak is bursting with ideas. The studio puts out new mainline Pokémon adventures with a machinelike precision. But every so often it launches a curious experiment, whether it's an action title about a militarized elephant or turning horse races into a card game, showing that it's capable of more than the latest generation of pocket monsters. That's part of what makes the idea of Beast of Reincarnation so enticing. Here is an established studio breaking free of the franchise it has become known for to make its take on a blockbuster action game. Unfortunately new ideas are in short supply in Beast, an …
Read the full story at The Verge.

ai.title: Telegram briefly pulled from the App Store over child sexual abuse material availability [U: Apple statement ]
ai.description:
Update: 11:00 p.m. ET: In a statement to 9to5Mac, Apple said:
“We briefly removed Telegram from the App Store after our review found content that violates our strict guidelines prohibiting child sexual abuse material. The app was subsequently restored after the developer promptly removed the content and banned the user who posted it.”
Apple’s statement came about 20 minutes after access to the app was restored. Earlier tonight, Telegram published a tongue-in-cheek post on X saying, “Reports of my demise are greatly exaggerated 🍎.” Telegram has yet to comment on the actual reason for its brief removal. The original story follows below.
Messaging platform Telegram appears to have been removed from the App Store in multiple countries, although the reason for its apparent removal remains unclear.
